business_scope.primary_industry_name: Interactive Language Education and Automated Tutoring Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (Republic of Vanuatu) - International Company (IC) regime under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); statutory tax-exempt offshore status for qualifying ICs.
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - English common law foundation, French civil law influence, and indigenous customary law recognition (Constitution of Vanuatu, Articles 47(1) and 95(1)-(3)); unitary republic within the Commonwealth.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) with Australia (signed 2010, in force 2011)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) with New Zealand (in force 2011)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus) - multilateral free trade agreement in force 2020, ratified by Vanuatu
Samoa Agreement (OACPS-EU Partnership Agreement, successor to the Cotonou Agreement) - signed November 2023, provisionally applicable
WTO Membership - Vanuatu acceded 24 August 2012, bringing GATS coverage for cross-border EdTech services

None - Vanuatu has no comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or full income tax double taxation agreement with major capital-exporting states; ICs rely on the statutory exemption from all Vanuatu taxes under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2021, which repeals and replaces Act No. 7 of 2006 and strengthens the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU); International Companies Act [Cap 222]; Company and International Trust Services Providers Act No. 21 of 2014 [Cap 257]; Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap 256]; VFSC AML/CFT Supervision Directives and VFIU reporting guidance; FATF Recommendations as adopted domestically. Vanuatu was removed from the FATF list of jurisdictions under increased monitoring in 2024.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - the beneficial ownership register is maintained confidentially by the VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and is not publicly searchable; disclosure is made only on lawful demand to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, the VFSC, or other competent authorities under the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2021 and Cap 257.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or Commissioner of Oaths in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - Vanuatu is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the notarized document must be legalized by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, External Trade and Cooperation (Port Vila) or a Vanuatu diplomatic/consular post (e.g., Permanent Mission to the UN, New York, or High Commission, Canberra)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each UBO and director (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last 6 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing utility company or financial institution in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization through the Vanuatu consular chain; Hague Apostille not accepted as Vanuatu is not an Apostille Convention contracting state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate shareholder evidence - Certificate of Incorporation, Register of Directors, Register of Members/UBO declaration of the intermediate holding company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction and its licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization of certified true copies by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs or Vanuatu consular post; original registry certification where available

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional bank reference letter for each UBO and director (stating status, years of relationship, and no adverse conduct)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank in the UBO's jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization; acceptable only when dated within 90 days of submission to the Vanuatu Registered Agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence on all UBOs, directors and signatories: identity verification; persistent screening against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT sanctions, and domestic VFIU advisory lists; mandatory PEP status capture with escalation to senior management for enhanced due diligence; negative news and adverse media checks; enhanced due diligence required where any UBO is a PEP, a family member or close associate of a PEP, or resident in a high-risk third country; STR filing to the VFIU within the statutory period under the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2021; re-screening at least annually and upon any trigger event.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.commercial_substance_and_tax_exposure_no: An International Company is exempt from Vanuatu income tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, business license tax and stamp duty on its international business; the EdTech subscription revenue from non-Vanuatu customers falls outside the Vanuatu domestic tax net; no audited financial statements are required for a standard IC where the public is not invited to subscribe. For payment rails (Apple IAP, Google Play Billing), no Vanuatu VAT/WST registration is required provided sales are made purely from outside Vanuatu.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.banking_aml_risk_tier_assessment: Low_Risk_Standard - the ISIC 6201 / NAICS 611710 interactive language education subscription business involves no regulated financial activity, no custody, no money transmission, and no high-risk jurisdiction concentration; however, the owning IC must maintain the UBO file at the Registered Agent to satisfy VFIU and international correspondent banking due diligence requests.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.corporate_governance_and_signing_authori: The IC may be managed by natural-person directors or a licensed corporate director; execution of contracts is typically delegated by a board resolution; no local resident director is required; powers of attorney for bank account or payment processor onboarding should be notarized and consular-legalized where demanded by the acquirer or financial institution.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry; name reservation and incorporation are submitted exclusively by a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent through the VFSC online corporate filing and search system; no direct public applicant access.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official register is maintained in English, with French recognized as a co-official statutory language. All registered names must be rendered in Roman/Latin script; a name in a non-Roman script (e.g., Chinese characters) is accepted only with a registered English transliteration, which becomes the official name for search and certification purposes. Required suffixes: Limited, Ltd., Corporation, Corp., Incorporated, Inc., or their French equivalents; the name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing registered name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Savings, Loan, Trust, Trustee, Assurance, Insurance, Reinsurance - require prior written approval from the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu or the relevant licensing authority
National, Government, State, Republic, Commonwealth, Municipal, City, Council - imply patronage of or connection with the Republic of Vanuatu or a public authority
University, Academy, Institute, College, School - education-sensitive tokens requiring Ministry of Education consent or a no-objection letter
Chartered, Royal, Imperial, Crown - imply royal or professional chartered status and require evidential consent
Vanuatu, VU, VFSC, FIU - imply official government or regulatory affiliation and are generally refused
Any name that is defamatory, obscene, contrary to public policy, or so similar to an existing company, trademark or registered name as to cause confusion (International Companies Act [Cap 222])
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: the initial 30-day reservation may be extended once for a further 30 days by written request to the VFSC submitted prior to expiry, with payment of the prescribed extension fee (approx. USD 50). Rejection SOP: 1) The Registered Agent files a written VFSC Name Reconsideration Request within 14 calendar days of the refusal, attaching three alternative names and any no-objection letter from the competent authority (e.g., Reserve Bank of Vanuatu for bank/trust tokens; Ministry of Finance for national tokens; Ministry of Education for university/institute tokens). 2) The VFSC re-evaluates and issues a written decision within 10 business days. 3) If the request is again refused, the applicant may file a formal administrative appeal to the VFSC Board and thereafter a judicial review application in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu, typically within 21 days of the final written refusal, invoking the Court's constitutional review jurisdiction. 4) Practical fallback: resubmit with a distinctive prefix or suffix (e.g., LinguaLeap Learning Ltd) and, where relevant, annex a trademark registration or no-objection letter to reduce confusion risk.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this EdTech profile - every International Company must maintain a statutory registered office at a physical address in Vanuatu provided by the VFSC-licensed Registered Agent (International Companies Act [Cap 222] s. 32; Cap 257); the operator may conduct the entire business remotely with no local employees, lease or physical presence. No separate virtual office lease is required for a standard IC. This assessment does not apply to regulated financial dealer activities, which require a local compliance presence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - quantified at approximately 5-10% annual probability of a VFSC on-site inspection of the Registered Agent's AML/CFT files; direct unannounced physical inspection of the beneficial owner's overseas business premises is below 5% for this Low_Risk_Standard subscription EdTech profile, but increases if the UBO is a PEP or sanctions-adjacent person, in which case the Registered Agent must be able to produce the UBO register and CDD records at the VFSC on demand.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and name reservation fee (approval valid 30 days)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] VFSC published fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC International Company incorporation registration fee (authorised capital up to USD 10,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] VFSC published fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year annual licensing fee for the International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] VFSC published fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC-licensed Registered Agent and statutory registered office provision (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed Corporate and Trust Services Provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark quoted by VFSC-licensed registered agents in Port Vila

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT onboarding, UBO register set-up, PEP and OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark under Cap 257 AML/CFT obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization bundle for passport, address proof, corporate evidence and bank reference (three UBO documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in country of origin plus Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs or Vanuatu consular post
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark comprising notary tariffs and Vanuatu consular fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International courier and expedited document handling for the legalized package

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu), sections 1-6 (incorporation), 13-18 (memorandum and articles), 29-36 (share capital), 51-53 (registered office and agent), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2012 and the Companies and Limited Partnerships (Amendment) Act 2016 (economic substance provisions); administered under the Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 256].
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: International Companies Registry, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association submitted with Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; authorised capital may be expressed in any currency and stated up to 10,000 shares at the standard fee. Allotment consideration may be cash or non-cash. No escrow account requirement applies. International companies are wholly exempt from Vanuatu income, withholding and capital gains taxes under section 153 of the Act; pure IT/software activities are outside the economic substance reporting scope.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the incorporation of the Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] be and is hereby approved, and the registered agent is authorised to file the Memorandum and Articles with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Company adopt its registered office at the agent's address in Port Vila, and that [Name] (Director), [Name] (Secretary) and [Name] (President) be and are hereby appointed to serve until the next annual general meeting, with authority to open bank accounts, execute the platform subscription agreements and approve the share issue to the founding subscriber.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Companies Registry, VFSC (submitted electronically via a VFSC-licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name availability request through the appointed registered agent, stating the proposed name, permitted business objects and capital structure. The Registry checks identical or confusingly similar names and regulated words. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 30 days pending incorporation.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (up to 3 alternatives)
Statement of intended business scope (ISIC 6201 EdTech software services)
Subscriber and director identification summary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the applicant may file a written request for Registrar review within 14 days or submit fresh alternative names for immediate re-screening; no additional state fee for resubmission within the 30-day reservation window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC (agent licensing under sections 90-96 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222])
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent engagement agreement. The agent performs customer due diligence on the beneficial owner, verifies identity documents, confirms non-resident ownership eligibility, and files the declaration with the VFSC per the AML/CFT framework. The agent will serve as the company's registered office holder in Port Vila.
required_dossiers: Signed registered agent engagement letter
Certified passport copy of each director and shareholder
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, less than 3 months old)
Beneficial ownership declaration form
Brief curriculum vitae of the proposed director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent declines due diligence clearance or business-risk mismatch, the applicant may engage an alternative VFSC-licensed agent; refusal grounds must be documented and may be cured by providing enhanced KYC evidence or a corporate bank reference.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The agent drafts the standard-form Memorandum and Articles with authorised share capital (e.g., 50,000 ordinary shares of USD 0.01 each), general objects clause covering computer programming, interactive language education and automated tutoring software, and provisions permitting online board meetings. The sole subscriber and director execute the documents in counterparts or via electronic signature.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber resolution adopting the articles
Consent to act as first director and secretary
Statement of authorised capital and proposed par value
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Pre-filing commentary from the Registry may require amendments to permitted objects or capital wording; amended articles are re-executed by the subscriber without re-notarisation where the original is already notarised.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of State Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, consents, agent acceptance and the USD 350 government fee via the VFSC treasury. Signatures are certified by the agent; the Registry validates the documents against the reserved name and capital statement.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation
Exported Memorandum and Articles (bilingual English/French optional)
Consent of registered agent
Consent of directors
Proof of state fee payment (VFSC receipt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query or requisition letter, the agent files a written response within 14 calendar days; ministerial corrections are effected by an amended filing, and any excess fees are refunded or applied to annual renewal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Company Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the company number and date of incorporation. The agent obtains the certificate, company seal (optional), share certificates, statutory registers and minute book, and arranges delivery of the corporate kit to the client digitally and by courier.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued by Registrar)
Share certificates for founding subscriber allotment
Registered office and agent confirmation notice
Extract of public register entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains minor clerical errors, the Registrar will issue an amended certificate upon written application and payment of the nominal correction fee; substantive errors are cured by restating the register under section 18 of the Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Initial Governance Records and Annual Substance Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Holding the first board meeting, the company adopts the first board resolution, opens the statutory registers (directors, members, charges and beneficial owners), issues the subscriber share allotment, and appoints the registered office. The agent files the annual renewal declaration and economic substance notification; pure software subscription companies are outside the economic substance relevant-activity definition and need no substantive presence in Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
Register of directors, members and UBOs
Subscriber share allotment ledger
Annual renewal and substance declaration form
Registered office address confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late annual renewal within 60 days of the anniversary is cured by payment of the penalty schedule; failure to maintain a registered agent results in Registrar strike-off, which may be remedied by reinstatement application with arrears and reinstatement fees.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board applies to computer programming and EdTech subscription services; corporate oversight remains with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, and any physical office requires a local business permit from the Port Vila Municipal Council under the Municipalities Act [Cap 126].
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating licence is required for interactive language education and automated tutoring software (ISIC 6201). An ancillary Municipal Business Licence may apply solely where the company maintains a physical office in Port Vila.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Software-only digital service not listed in Schedule 3 of the Environment Management and Conservation Act [Cap 283]; no EIA registration, scoping or full EIA report required for the EdTech activity
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for server-based operations. If a leased office operates locally, compliance applies to Port Vila Municipal wastewater discharge limits, solid waste segregation and hazardous e-waste disposal under the Waste Management Regulations 2016; no direct VOC or process emission thresholds triggered by software development activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire Service for any leased office floor, structural load and occupancy inspection by the Port Vila Municipal Building Inspector under the Town Planning and Building Act [Cap 235], and workplace registration under the Employment (Health and Safety at Work) Act with basic first-aid and emergency-exit compliance for the small administrative workforce.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Vanuatu; official portal: https://customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must first be incorporated or registered as an International Company with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). Submission of the completed VAT/TIN registration application (Form VAT-1) is then required to the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, registered office certificate, constitution, director and shareholder identification documents, and proof of registered agent in Vanuatu. The Department issues the statutory VAT registration number and Tax Identification Number within approximately five business days after due compliance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: An International Company may, by special resolution filed with the VFSC and Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, elect to become a resident company under Part 16 of the International Companies Act Cap 222 and thereby forgo the statutory tax exemption and become subject to domestic VAT and any future income tax measures. No U.S.-style check-the-box election exists; hybrid mismatch elections are not applicable as Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act Cap 247
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 annual aggregate taxable turnover (excluding zero-rated supplies) in Vanuatu; registration is mandatory within 14 days from the end of the month in which the threshold is exceeded.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not yet mandate real-time fiscal clearance, electronic digital stamping, or API-based invoice clearance. Taxpayers must issue prescribed VAT invoices (in English or French), retain electronic and paper records for seven years, and file periodic VAT returns; the Department may conduct on-site audits of invoicing processes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods supplied to a person outside Vanuatu and physically exported within 60 days, and to services supplied to non-residents where the place of supply is outside Vanuatu, including online EdTech subscription services delivered via Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, or internet-based automated tutoring platforms. The supplier must possess documentary evidence that the goods or services were provided to a recipient outside Vanuatu, payment was received in foreign currency, and the value was not consumed or used in Vanuatu. Associated input VAT may be refunded.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration / Electronic Export Manifest (for physical goods)
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or equivalent proof of export (for physical goods)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank/merchant settlement statement evidencing receipt of export consideration in foreign currency
Signed export contract / online subscription agreement evidencing the non-resident recipient and offshore delivery
System usage or delivery logs demonstrating that the EdTech service was accessed and consumed outside Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Department of Customs and Inland Revenue may conduct retrospective assessments up to 6 years (unlimited in fraud), and may claw back zero-rated input credits and output VAT if the exporter has not substantiated physical departure, offshore delivery, or foreign-currency receipt within the statutory period. Penalties include fines up to VUV 5,000,000 and imprisonment for tax evasion, civil penalties up to 200% of the evaded VAT, cancellation of the zero-rating registration, and personal liability of directors and officers involved in fraudulent export refund claims.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains full current and capital account convertibility under Article VIII of the IMF Articles of Agreement. There are no exchange controls, no prior approval requirements for foreign currency transactions, and profits, dividends, and other returns on investment may be freely repatriated. The domestic currency is the Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) with a floating exchange rate; a licensed local bank may require a declaration for cash transactions exceeding threshold but will not block approved wire transfers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement in Vanuatu. Exporters may hold, convert, or remit overseas earnings freely, subject only to normal anti-money laundering and counter-financing of terrorism verification and the bank's internal risk-based monitoring.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: No dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) licensing framework exists in Vanuatu, and overseas digital EMIs cannot directly hold bank charters or access local payment rails without a Vanuatu banking license or an explicit correspondent arrangement through a licensed domestic bank. Feasibility for a foreign-regulated EMI as a primary treasury rail is Low; the recommended pathway is a local commercial bank account with SWIFT connectivity and a regulated fintech payment orchestration layer for merchant settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors are not legally required to appear physically in every case. Most Vanuatu banks permit remote account opening via certified corporate documents, notarised director identification, and video interviews conducted by the compliance team. However, if the beneficial owner or a senior director is resident in a high-risk jurisdiction, or if the corporate structure involves bearer patterns or complex ownership layers, a physical visit to the bank's branch in Port Vila or Santo will be mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of physical substance in Vanuatu for an International Company with overseas management
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified registered agent confirmation, lease agreement for the registered office, annual return filing confirmation from Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, board minutes appointing authorised signatories, and a clear description of the offshore treasury management function.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital subscription revenue sourced from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing without conventional customer invoices
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apple and Google merchant account statements, raw subscriber transaction logs, app store analytics reports, the commercial licensing agreement between the EdTech developer and the Vanuatu entity, and a standard refund policy demonstrating legitimate commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border wire traffic from and to multiple jurisdictions at volumes inconsistent with the declared EdTech business model
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CFO-prepared cash flow projections, treasury reporting pack, list of counterparty jurisdictions and purpose of payments (royalties, cloud hosting, employee remuneration, marketing), and the audited financial statements evidencing that revenue is generated by mobile application subscriptions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP-related risk triggered by nationality or residence of beneficial owners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Recent sanctions screening results from a recognised CDD provider (e.g., World-Check or LexisNexis), passport copies, proof of source of funds via bank statements, sworn statutory declaration of legitimacy and anti-money laundering declaration signed by the client.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inward remittance must be executed via SWIFT MT103 from the ultimate shareholder's bank account. The payment should carry the purpose code corresponding to 'Shareholder Loan' or 'Equity Contribution' depending on the Internal Company's capital and loan records; the receiving bank in Vanuatu is the licensed domestic commercial bank holding the capital escrow or operational account. Verification will require a board resolution authorising the borrowing, a signed loan agreement or equity subscription contract, and a certification from the company secretary confirming the latest registered shareholding. The value date should not be split into multiple small transfers unless each tranche references the original purpose code to avoid structuring concerns.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements for the EdTech platform (hosting fees, marketing, app store fees, content licensing, software development services) should be cleared through SWIFT MT103 wires from the Vanuatu operating account. For high-value or contractually significant purchases, a Commercial Letter of Credit (documentary credit, UCP 600) issued by ANZ or if required cleared through a corresponding bank is permissible, along with regular telegraphic transfer (TT) and Resource Payment Orders where supported by the beneficiary jurisdiction. The bank will require the underlying commercial contract, supplier invoice, and any applicable withholding tax confirmation if the beneficiary is located in a country with treaty arrangements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanuatu Vatu / USD forward contracts with tenors up to 12 months where available through the RBV market connection
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts on USD/JPY and EUR/USD referencing major liquidity centres for non-VUV exposures
Cross-currency swap (USD to EUR) with a licensed counterparty to hedge the EUR-denominated content licensing and marketing costs
USD/VUV spot and outright forward hedging for anticipated inbound investment capital repatriation timing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of an International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via Licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days following each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts a VFSC late fee of VUV 25,000 (approx. USD 220); continued default beyond one year may trigger application by the registered agent for administrative strike-off, with assets vesting in the Republic of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Maintenance / License Fee Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on each anniversary of incorporation; collectively remitted by the registered agent on or before the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A 20% late payment surcharge is applied after the anniversary date; unpaid fees for 90 days lead to a default notice and inclusion in the strike-off list; dissolution ordinarily proceeds after six months of non-payment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered Agent Compliance Declaration and Register Review
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (VFSC-supervised) on behalf of the company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: To be completed during the preparation of the annual return, on or before the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct statutory fee; failure to maintain current registered-agent records or to keep the statutory registers may result in a VFSC penalty order and civil enforcement against the company and the registered agent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit applies to a Vanuatu International Company unless (i) its articles require an auditor, (ii) it is admitted to listing or licensed as a regulated financial services provider by VFSC, or (iii) shareholders holding at least 10% of voting shares demand an audit by written requisition.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vanuatu International Companies Act (Cap 222) as amended; accounting records in English sufficient to disclose and explain transactions and financial position; IFRS not statutorily mandated for unlisted ICs, though voluntary adoption of IFRS or a simple accruals/cash basis is acceptable.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu IC legislation does not require a separate annual UBO filing with VFSC. The registered agent must maintain current customer due diligence and beneficial ownership records, and the company must update the Register of Members within 14 days of any share transfer. At each annual return cycle, the registered agent reconciles membership, directorship, and ultimate beneficial ownership and obtains a written confirmation from the directors that the records are accurate.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (permanent zero-rate regime; an International Company is exempt from all corporate income tax under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222])
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No preferential holiday is needed; qualifying ICs are wholly exempt from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax, and stamp duty on income. Loss carryforward is irrelevant at a 0% effective rate; a 5-year benchmark applies only in hypothetical transitional assessments.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No income tax return exists for an International Company. The operative filings are the VFSC Annual Return and the Annual Economic Substance Declaration, submitted through the registered agent on the VFSC e-registry portal (VFSC eServices).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Return: within 30 days of each anniversary of incorporation. Economic Substance Declaration: within 6 months after the financial year-end (31 December).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company legal name, file number, and incorporation date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders are not disclosed on the public form; the registered agent's details are listed instead.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office in Vanuatu and licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical Vanuatu address through the licensed agent is mandatory; a PO Box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, secretary, and members; share capital and share classes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All may be non-resident; nominee officers may be used, but the beneficial ownership register must be maintained with the agent for VFSC inspection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance declaration identifying any relevant activity (e.g., distribution and service center, headquarters, or IP holding) and local substance indicators (employees, premises, expenditure, board meetings).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-owned EdTech IC must either demonstrate Vanuatu substance or qualify for the passive foreign-income holding exemption by proving no Vanuatu-source activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or non-filing of the Annual Return triggers late fees on the annual registry fee, suspension of good-standing certificates, and strike-off/dissolution after prolonged default; false substance declarations attract VFSC civil penalties and referral for criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by an International Company to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Treaty relief is unnecessary at source because domestic WHT is nil. Where a foreign jurisdiction requires proof under the limited DTA network (e.g., the Vanuatu–UAE DTA), the IC obtains a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incorporation; the Commissioner of Customs and Inland Revenue acts as competent authority and may issue a Certificate of Tax Residence for MAP/EOIR purposes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0% on cross-border IP royalties (EdTech software license fees) and debt interest paid by an IC. Under applicable DTAs, source-state taxation is capped at 0–5% for beneficial owners; domestic zero-rate prevails.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Transfer Pricing law, Local File, or Master File obligation exists in Vanuatu for International Companies; no VUV threshold is prescribed. Arm's-length pricing is nonetheless recommended to protect foreign-payer deductions and avoid foreign CFC/PE challenges.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The 2018 economic substance framework (International Companies Act [Cap. 222] as amended, administered by VFSC) applies to ICs carrying on relevant activities, including headquarters, distribution and service centers, and IP holding. An IC deriving EdTech subscription and licensing income must evidence real management control in Vanuatu (local office, employees, expenditure, board meetings) and file an annual substance return; passive IP-holding and conduit structures without Vanuatu substance are vulnerable to VFSC scrutiny and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Earning Vanuatu-sourced revenue (direct B2C EdTech subscriptions to Vanuatu residents or in-country distribution) while falsely classifying it as foreign-source exempt income to avoid the 12.5% VAT and fiscal duties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil reassessment for unpaid VAT with late penalties and statutory interest; anti-avoidance penalties and publication orders under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 241]; criminal prosecution for false declarations with fines and imprisonment on conviction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors involved in the misdeclaration are jointly and severally liable for restitution; the Court may issue departure prohibition (travel ban) and asset-freezing orders pending tax and criminal proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Vanuatu-registered IC that collects global EdTech subscription and IP royalties through nominee officers with zero local employees, premises, board activity, or expenditure in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC monetary penalties for failure to file the economic substance declaration; removal of good standing; and strike-off/dissolution under the International Companies Act, with referral to foreign competent authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors may be held personally liable for losses caused by substance misstatements, disqualified from managing Vanuatu companies, and exposed to civil restitution in foreign tax proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain a licensed registered agent, concealing ultimate beneficial owners from the VFSC register, or processing EdTech subscription payments through Apple IAP/Google Play rails without customer due diligence and AML/CTF screening.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties and regulatory sanctions under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2019; suspension of the corporate registration; asset-freezing orders by the Vanuatu FIU; criminal prosecution for money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individuals concerned in management commit an offence and face personal fines and custodial sentences on conviction; civil liability attaches for restitution and directors may be subject to travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Offshore Conduit Misuse and Foreign GAAR Exposure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing global EdTech subscription revenue through the Vanuatu IC while actual development, contracting, and management occur elsewhere, leaving the IC with no commercial risk, employees, or profit substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In Vanuatu, characterization as an unregulated shell and deregistration with information exchange; abroad, CFC/controlled-foreign-company attribution, permanent establishment assessment, and general anti-avoidance recharacterization of the entire revenue stream.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face civil liability for fraudulent misrepresentation to foreign tax authorities and criminal liability where the IC's certificates are used to mislead foreign revenue bodies.
